get_version: read the version file and extract the __version__ string using exec and compile
setup_sphinx_app: connect the builder-inited event to the builder_inited_handler in the Sphinx app
builder_inited_handler: run the stat.py script as a subprocess when the Sphinx builder initializes
configure_sphinx_autodoc: configure Sphinx autodoc with mock imports for matplotlib, pycocotools, and mmcv.ops
configure_sphinx_html_theme: set the Sphinx HTML output theme to sphinx_rtd_theme with custom static files
